notes: Re-validated live 2026-09-28 (v0.5.9). placeId (which STORE's prices) is USER-CONFIGURABLE via config.json siteContext['colruyt.be'].placeId — never hardcoded; default 604 = Colruyt Halle. The API honours any placeId anonymously (604/902/886 return different assortments and prices); the website itself ignores tms_storeperma / ?placeId for anonymous sessions, so the API is the only store lever. X-CG-APIKey is a static public app key embedded in every page as an entity-encoded config ('"headers":["X-CG-APIKey: <key>"'); plain HTTP with a browser User-Agent works (without a UA the gateway answers 456). categoryId is read from the category page itself (data-model-url …/alle-categorieen/<parent>/<id>/jcr:content — the LAST id), replacing a static category_map whose ids had drifted to other categories. The response exposes no store identity (no store guard possible). field_map follows today's API: LongName (brand + name + size), price.basicPrice, commercialArticleNumber; the product URL is built from commercialArticleNumber (the API carries none). GTIN is intentionally unmapped: its array may lead with a case/pack GTIN. When the free key resolution fails, the host can opt into the Scraping Browser header bootstrap (config brightData.scrapingBrowserBootstrap['colruyt.be']).
